prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
competitors_mentioned: Daniel J. McDevitt of McDevitt & Cobb
Chicago Bar Association Lawyer Referral Service
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” Chicago car-accident attorney—the right choice depends on your injuries, the facts, and the lawyer’s experience with similar claims.

One reasonable starting point is **Daniel J. McDevitt of McDevitt & Cobb**: the available results say he handles car and other motor-vehicle injury claims and has been selected to Illinois Super Lawyers repeatedly. That recognition is a useful signal, not a guarantee that he’s the best fit for your case. You could also compare several attorneys through the **Chicago Bar Association Lawyer Referral Service**, which says it screens participating lawyers for experience and malpractice insurance: **312-554-2001**.

Before hiring anyone, ask who will handle your case day to day, how many similar cases they’ve handled, how fees and case costs work, and whether they’ll take the case on contingency. Check the attorney’s current license and disciplinary history with the Illinois ARDC, and speak with at least two firms.
